outlook.statement: Confident in ability to deliver sustainable value creation; strategy to invest in innovation, enhance operational efficiency, mitigate external risks, and pursue disciplined growth opportunities across markets.

The stress is a temporary disruption in global funding and procurement cycles, rather than any decline in product relevance, regulatory standing, manufacturing capability, or market acceptance. The Company continues to retain its WHO approvals and long-standing relationships with international formulators.

Continue focused investments in process intensification initiatives and advanced manufacturing technologies to enhance productivity and operational flexibility. Pursue opportunities for backward integration of critical intermediates to improve supply chain resilience, cost efficiency, and business continuity. Further strengthen research and development infrastructure to support complex generic products and advanced synthetic chemistry platforms. Accelerate sustainability-driven initiatives, including adoption of green chemistry principles and environmentally responsible manufacturing practices.
The long-term outlook for the pharmaceutical sector remains positive, supported by innovation, demographic trends and growing global healthcare expenditure.

Government initiatives such as the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme, Promotion of Bulk Drug Parks, support for domestic Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing and continued investments in healthcare infrastructure are expected to strengthen the industry's long-term growth prospects.
Increasing investments in research and development, specialty pharmaceuticals, biologics and biosimilars are expected to drive the next phase of growth for the Indian pharmaceutical industry.
The Indian CDMO sector is well-positioned to capture a larger share of the global pharmaceutical outsourcing market in the coming years.
